footer.title_desc: AI web application to recognize, classify and support first aid for wounds.

home_page.hero_desc: SkinAid supports everyday users by combining wound detection, tailored first aid guidance, and easy-to-use wound history tracking into a user-friendly web application, designed to make healthcare more accessible and practical in everyday life.
home_page.feature_title_desc: A simple tool to help users detect wounds, receive first-aid guidance, and track wound history.
home_page.feature_card1_desc: Upload and manage wound images with detailed information.
home_page.feature_card1_item1: Detect and categorize different wound types
home_page.feature_card1_item2: Provide simple results in user-friendly format
home_page.feature_card1_item3: Store and organize your wound images
home_page.feature_card2_desc: Offer standardized first-aid steps tailored to wound type.
home_page.feature_card3_desc: Enable users to track and review their wound images.
home_page.how_work_desc: From image capture to AI analysis and treatment recommendations, see how SkinAid transforms wound care documentation in three simple steps.
home_page.how_work_step1_desc: Upload high-resolution wound images using standardized imaging protocols for unified documentation.
home_page.how_work_step2_desc: Advanced AI algorithms will analyze the wound, provide measurements, classify and assess the extent of the wound.
home_page.how_work_step3_desc: Get standardized treatment recommendations and first aid guidance from reputable medical sources.
home_page.how_work_step3_item2: Wash your hands with soap and water.
home_page.how_work_step3_item3: Use a clean gauze/cloth to apply direct pressure to stop the bleeding.
home_page.how_work_step3_item4: Wash the wound with clean water or saline solution.
home_page.how_work_step3_item5: Lightly disinfect the wound, avoid deep penetration.
home_page.how_work_step3_item6: Let dry, cover with sterile gauze or medical tape.
home_page.how_work_step3_item7: Rest, avoid impact on the injured area.
home_page.why_skinaid_item1_desc: Identifies >3 common wound types (Burns, Abrasions, Cuts...).
home_page.why_skinaid_item2_desc: First aid process based on WHO/Ministry of Health data.
home_page.why_skinaid_item3_desc: No medical knowledge required, accessible to everyone.
home_page.why_skinaid_item4_desc: Save wound history for easy progress monitoring.
home_page.medical_disclaimer: SkinAid is a first aid support tool and does not replace diagnosis and treatment by a specialist. In case of emergency, please visit a medical facility immediately.
